tools.name: NinjaOne
tools.description: iVenture's RMM. Agent-based inventory, monitoring, patching, scripting and remote access for Windows, macOS and Linux devices.
tools.product_reference: iVenture Managed PC / Managed Server (per device)
capabilities: Workstations and servers with the NinjaOne agent
Hardware, operating system, IP and MAC address, last check-in
Installed software on each device
OS and third-party patch status and install history
gaps: Devices without the agent: network gear, printers, IoT, unmanaged or personal devices, most phones
Asset owner, department and approved-to-connect, unless captured in custom fields
Business purpose and authorization of software
Cloud and SaaS services with no endpoint
possible_records: Device inventory export for the organization
OS and software patch compliance reports
verification_hints: Device count reconciles with ConnectWise configurations and the agreement device count
Devices not checked in for 30+ days are reviewed or retired
Patch policy approves and installs within the iVenture window
tools.source_note: Supplied reference snapshot, 2026-11-18; deployment and assurance require separate confirmation.
